purpose: Record existing focused workflow behavior and setup health before any Referral Canvas component refactor, while explicitly preserving the gaps found by the technical trace.

commands.command: PORT=3119 npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/pipeline-smoke.spec.ts --grep 'coordinates section edits|recovers a tab-scoped draft|requires explicit human review before joining'
covered: two-session section edits, presence leases, and remote conflict presentation
tab-scoped referral draft recovery after refresh followed by section autosave
explicit candidate creation and separate human confirmation before joining records

commands.command: PORT=3120 npx playwright test -c playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/pipeline-smoke.spec.ts --grep 'schedules, completes, signs, and recalls an assessment'
covered: assessment scheduling, beginning, completion, signing, and recall happy path
pure master-matching identity rules, including resident-number plus conflicting DOB

commands.command: npm run check:refactor-guidance && npm run check:refactor-setup
covered: guidance fixtures and active control structure
warnings: referral-canvas-components is not start-ready because its owner, approval, approved file disposition, assurance record, autosave/conflict recovery evidence, identity/evidence characterization, and owner assurance record are incomplete

knownUncoveredFindings.summary: Resident-link create/confirm does not enforce the referral-versus-governed-resident DOB conflict at the server mutation boundary.
Extraction evidence review can commit before the referral projection fails, with no automatic repair contract.
The final identity review omits candidate evidence and does not hydrate current state after a stale-version response.
Custom modal dialogs do not implement focus entry, containment, and invoker-focus restoration.
Immediate assessment unmount during recovery/working-set timer windows and in-flight saves is not characterized.
A fresh assessment command invocation generates a new mutation id after an ambiguous response.

claimBoundary: These commands preserve only their named behaviors on the recorded commit. They do not cover the listed findings, authorize a structural slice, certify refactor readiness, or establish whole-application correctness.
